about_the_game:
The Builder and Power-Up Set includes the following content:
• Builders' Vault Bundle
- Additional Builders Parts/Emblems
- Additional Diorama Items (Diorama Base, Diorama Objects, Diorama Gunpla)
- Enhance Items
Parts Enhance I x 200
Parts Enhance II x 200
Parts Enhance III x 200
- Evolve Items
Parts Evolve I x 200
Parts Evolve II x 200
• Power-up Booster Bundle
- Enhance Items
Parts Enhance IV x 200
Parts Enhance V x 200
Parts Enhance VI x 200
- Evolve Items
Parts Evolve III x 200
Parts Evolve IV x 200

*Individual DLCs can be purchased as standalone products. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Items in excess of the maximum number allowed will be discarded.
